Visual details from source observation: README 目录很长：Features、Installation、Quick Start、Optional Dependencies、Components、Theming、Utility Exports、TypeScript Support、Migration from v0.1.x，另有一段 Recent Updates。Theming 一节围绕 WidgetProvider 展开，近期提交里就有一条 fix: use WidgetProvider theme colors across all components。docs 目录是用 docsify 搭的文档页，另有 example 应用放欢迎页。About 强调 Works seamlessly with both Expo and bare React Native projects，MIT 许可，20 star。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
